test_cases.summary:
Verify system prevents save when Label Name is empty
when the user is on the Create Label form
test_cases.description:
Feature: Label Name Validation – Empty Name Block

Scenario: Verify system prevents save when Label Name is empty

Given the user is on the Create Label form
When the user leaves the Label Name field empty
And clicks Save
Then the system should prevent submission
And show toast message “Name is required”
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should prevent submission
The behavior should be validated when the user leaves the Label Name field empty.

The behavior should be validated when validation fails.
